_meta.session: Session 64 — Generalist AI GEN-1 + 1X World Model Lab
_meta.notes: GEN-1 = NEW Generalist AI VLA model. Vendor-claimed scores from blog post (no peer-reviewed paper yet). KEY METRICS: 99% multi-task success vs GEN-0 64% / from-scratch 19%. 3x faster on dexterous tasks. Box folding 12.1 sec (2.8x faster than π0/GEN-0 ~34 sec). Phone packing 15.5 sec. Training: 500K+ hours physical interaction data + low-cost wearable device data on humans (NOT teleoperation). Architecture: Large multimodal action model with 'Harmonic Reasoning' inference. Also added GEN-0 (referenced as prior version) for comparison. 1X World Model Lab is org announcement (Sam Sinha ex-Luma AI heading); no new bench scores but updated 1x/world-model with refreshed lab-launch context.
